d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ke nirdharit bihar daure ko lekar janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke neta shyam rajak ne patna men midiya se batchit karte hue apni pratikriya di hai. JDU neta shyam rajak ne pradhanmantri ke aagman ko bihar ke lie gaurav ki bat batate hue kaha ki sabhi log unke svagat ke lie bhav-vibhor hain.
